{"id":"persona-5s4b.111","title":"Docs and a user-facing error name persona.service; the shipped unit is personad.service","description":"Three documents and one error message name a systemd unit that does not exist.

  DESIGN.md:47    **User systemd unit (Linux):** persona.service
  SPEC-HIA.md:47  same line
  README.md:108   | Linux (systemd) | persona.service (user unit) |
  persona/src/main.rs:64  error text: "Is personad running? Try: systemctl --user start persona"

The shipped unit is systemd/personad.service, and 'persona install-service' writes personad.service (persona/src/main.rs:506-508). README.md:135 tells the reader 'systemctl --user enable --now personad', contradicting its own table 27 lines earlier.

main.rs:64 is the worst of the four: it is the message a user sees precisely when the socket is missing, and it sends them to a unit name that will fail.

Found during persona-5s4b.110 by the doc-consistency verifier.
